sn46.10:1.1: “Bhikkhus, these seven factors of enlightenment, developed and cultivated, if unarisen do not arise apart from the Discipline of a Fortunate One.
sn46.10:1.3: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.10:1.4: These seven factors of enlightenment, developed and cultivated, if unarisen do not arise apart from the Discipline of a Fortunate One.”
